Title: New additions to the Azure Archive Storage partner network

Body.Content:
Azure Archive Storage is now integrated with new partners including IBM Spectrum Protect Plus, NetApp StorageGRID®, Rubrik, and Veritas NetBackupTM., making the partner network even more comprehensive. Other Azure Archive Storage partners include Archive360, CloudBerry Lab, Cohesity, Commvault, HubStor, Igneous, NetApp, and Tiger Technology. Invent with purpose and build optimal storage solutions for varying workloads with the help of our partners.

  • IBM Spectrum Protect Plus offers SLA-centric management with end-to-end policies that automate the entire data protection process with Azure hot, cool, and archive storage tiers as an option for reduced storage costs.
  • NetApp StorageGRID® uses intelligent, policy-driven data management to optimize their data-storage efficiency with support for the hot, cool, and archive tiers of Azure Blob storage as a public cloud target, enabling you to take advantage of cost-efficient storage service from Azure.
  • Rubrik delivers a single, policy-driven platform for data recovery with support for archiving data to Blob storage, including hot, cool, and archive tiers.
  • Veritas NetBackupTM eliminates complexity around data security and availability with support for workload backup and recovery to Azure hot, cool, and archive storage tiers for cost savings and long-term retention.

Partners have helped our customers discover and retain value from their data since the launch of Azure Archive Storage in 2017. Redefine your data storage strategy and run your businesses efficiently with the help of these added partners.

Learn more about Azure Archive Storage.
